content:
Apple One bundles multiple popular Apple services together with discounts, and in iOS 27 the high-end Premier plan will gain several new advantages.

Apple One Premier is gaining two upgrades in iOS 27, both related to Apple Intelligence.

If you're an Apple One user and need another reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 may just give you one.

The new iPhone operating system software brings two upgrades to the high-end Apple One plan.

  • Apple Home AI features
  • Higher image generation usage limits and other upgrades

Apple's Home app will gain a suite of AI features in iOS 27, some of which will be exclusive to iCloud+ subscribers on the 2TB plan. That means you'll need to subscribe to either Apple One Premier or the top standalone iCloud+ plan to access them.

It remains unclear whether all of the AI features require a subscription, or only some. The iOS 27 beta notes simply state: "Apple Intelligence for Home requires an iCloud+ subscription of 2TB or higher."

However, upgrades to HomeKit secure video will most likely require at least the high-end plan. These include generating video descriptions, searching within video clips, and highlighting moments worth noticing.

If you need a camera that supports HomeKit secure video, here are my recommendations:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: priced at just US$35, a great value choice
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: supports 4K recording, but is more expensive at US$59

Beyond that, some new AI features in iOS 27 (such as image generation) come with daily usage limits. According to Apple, Apple One Premier subscribers will enjoy higher usage caps:

The iCloud+ plan bundled with Apple One's Individual tier does not qualify. So if you want higher AI usage limits, that's another reason to choose Apple One Premier.

Apple One plans start at US$19.95 per month and also include Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+ and more.
